solutionSql:
SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM shipments AS s
  WHERE s.customer_id = c.id
    AND s.weight_kg >= 900
)
ORDER BY c.id;
notes: Customers 1 to 6 each qualify. Customers 7 and 8 have no shipments.
